visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: map Instead of Hand-Written Indexes
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Every item of the 2 by 3 matrix is written out by hand into the result. Build the transpose with map for any size. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The hand-written version works only for a 2 by 3 matrix. Mapping over the columns and then over the rows works for any size.
